method: Past-only7-sample quadratic derivative fit, exponentially decaying horizontal acceleration; compare later observed alive positions at each model flight horizon.
limits: Offline future positions used only for error measurement, not runtime policy.
Censored by later kills/removals and route duration; center predictions, not collision or full-route proof.
Each model has its own vertical-velocity-derived horizon rounded to nearest60Hz sample. Raw samples retain both horizons.
